summary: Delivered the non-fork Vite/Vite+ command seam without adding a runtime transform: official TSRX framework plugins retain build/CSS/map/HMR ownership, while public packages oxlint-tsrx and oxfmt-tsrx route ordinary sources to canonical tools and each TSRX source exactly once to the native Rust commands. Both Markless-pinned Vite+ 0.1.20 and current 0.2.4 pass lint, format, and check --fix in a physical consumer layout, including authored-base config semantics.

architecture.vite_runtime: OXC for TSRX adds no Vite transform or parser; the published @tsrx/vite-plugin-react compiler owns real production build and dev/HMR recompilation.
architecture.ordinary_lane: Canonical Oxlint 1.74.0 and Oxfmt 0.59.0 retain ordinary JavaScript/TypeScript behavior.
architecture.tsrx_lane: Thin Node commands discover files and launch oxc-tsrx/oxc-tsrx-fmt; scanning, projection, mappings, linting, fixes, and formatting remain Rust-native with one canonical OXC parse per normal TSRX file.
architecture.vite_plus: Vite+ uses its public project-local package/binary resolver with npm aliases named oxlint and oxfmt; no Vite+ private module, fork, patch, or source copy is used.
architecture.config: The public Vite+ resolveConfig API materializes only serializable lint/fmt fields. Native sessions receive the authored config base separately. Canonical tools reuse disposable JSON for base-insensitive configs and load the authored Vite config for object extends, overrides, ignores, or plugin paths.

initial_red: Real Vite build/HMR and Vite+ project-local command tests had no companion implementation or package shape.
The retained authored-base matrix failed on both Vite+ versions because relative extends resolved under the disposable temp directory.
The outside-config-root formatter regression reproduced a release SIGABRT in ignore::gitignore before the constant-time root guard.
green: 12/12 Vite/Vite+ tests pass, including official framework build, real watcher/HMR invalidation, both Vite+ versions, fixes, object extends, relative overrides, and rooted ignores.
Materialized config tests prove native object extends and exact config-root behavior for lint and format.
An outside-root explicit formatter input is treated as not ignored and no longer reaches the panic-prone matcher.

limitations: Platform-native npm artifacts are not produced yet; source development selects release binaries through explicit environment variables.
Type-aware tsgolint integration is queued as T029 and JavaScript plugins remain fail-closed pending a stable public upstream host.
Path-sensitive Vite configs may require one additional canonical config load, but no configuration work enters the per-file native hot path.
Vite+ 0.1.20 is retained only as an isolated legacy Markless control because advisories are fixed in 0.1.24 and later; 0.2.4 is the supported current control.
recommended_next: Activate T029 and implement the opt-in Rust-native type-semantic projection over the proven public TsGoLintState source-override seam without changing the default one-OXC-parse path.
